Tom H: Hi team - first week Q: my benefits portal still shows pending and my previous coverage ended 2026-04-30. Can we get health effective sooner? Also bought packing supplies ($32) and a taxi ($45) because movers missed delivery. Can I file those?

Benefits Bot: Auto: default effective = first of month after start. Exceptions possible with proof of prior coverage end. See benefits.redwood.com/new-hires.

Maya (People Ops): Welcome Tom! If prior coverage ended 2026-04-30 we can request an earlier effective date (e.g., 2026-05-01 -> retro to 2026-05-01) but we need proof (COBRA/termination). Please email benefits@redwood.com with subject "Retro Coverage Request - Tom H" and attach docs.

Tom H: Uploaded COBRA notice to benefits just now.

Maya (People Ops): Got it. For small moving items like boxes/tape we usually approve under $50 if bundled with mover invoice. Taxi due to mover delay can be reviewed; include short explanation and manager approval. Submit receipts via Expensify under "Relocation" or email benefits@redwood.com if you don't have that category.

Tom H: I don't see Relocation in Expensify yet. Who should I cc for manager approval?

Maya (People Ops): CC your manager or reply in thread with manager name. If you email benefits, use subject: "Relocation Reimburse - Tom H - [date]" and attach receipts + manager approval line.

Juan (Payroll): Note: reimbursements > $500 require prior approval; processing takes 1-2 payroll cycles after sign-off. Retroactive benefit costs will be applied as an adjustment once approved.

Tom H: Thanks all. Manager (Priya S) approved both items - emailing benefits now.

Benefits Bot: Ticket BEN-2026-0999 created. Benefits team will respond within 2 business days.

Tom H: Appreciate it :thumbsup:
